name: How do I choose the right style of decorative trim to match my home's interior?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right style of decorative trim to match my home's interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right trim style involves considering your home's existing architecture and your personal aesthetic preferences. For traditional homes, intricate profiles and layered moldings often complement the design. Modern homes might benefit from simpler, cleaner lines and bolder, minimalist profiles. We can discuss your home's era and existing elements during an initial consultation to help you select options that enhance its character. You might also gather inspiration from photos of interiors you admire to help clarify your vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your home's architectural style and your personal taste; intricate trim suits traditional homes, while simpler lines fit modern ones.
